summary: Iteration_4 frontend test of SafeBase Mobile Phase 1A — 5-stage IncidentWorkflow on http://localhost:3000 at 390x844. PARTIAL PASS. /incident register screen verified end-to-end: header 'Incidents' renders, subtitle 'Five-stage workflow…' present (1), red Report-an-incident button (testID report-incident-btn) tappable, stats grid has exactly 8 tiles (Total YTD/Notifiable/Lost Time/Medical/Near Miss/First Aid/Avg days/Open > 30d, all 0 for trades demo as expected), search input (incident-search) present, empty state EmptyState (incident-empty) rendered with shield icon. All 3 filter rows render — filter-stage-triage and filter-sev-3 verified visible. Modules tab incidents tile testID module-incidents routes to /incident NOT /module/incidents (regression PASS). /incident/new wizard Step 1 verified — all 4 INVOLVED_TYPES chips (involved-me / involved-other / involved-property / involved-near_miss) visible; involved-me selectable; Next advances to Step 2. Step 2 verified — description input, category-'Near Miss' chip, ai-categorise button, PhotoPicker showing both Camera and Library buttons. CRITICAL BLOCKER discovered while attempting Step 2→Step 3 navigation: the global floating Concierge widget ('TALK TO ME' yellow pill) intercepts the wizard's step-next button on the mobile viewport at the bottom-right of the screen. Tapping step-next on Step 2 navigates to /concierge (Ask-me-anything page) instead of advancing to Step 3. This blocks the entire submission flow, so Steps 3-6 (hurt/treatment/site/witness), the Reported→Triage→Investigation→Actions→Close-out workflow, and the post-submit Alert dialog for INC-YYYY-#### reference COULD NOT BE EXERCISED end-to-end. The first 'Next' tap (Step 1→Step 2) works because Step 1 content is short and step-next renders above the concierge widget; Step 2's taller content (description multiline + PhotoPicker block) pushes step-next into the floating concierge's hit zone. Repro is 100% on 390x844 viewport using force=True clicks via Playwright (browser hit-testing routes the click to the topmost concierge element). Note: when the user opened /modules then tapped Incidents tile in iter_4 run #1 the wizard also routed away from /incident/new mid-flow with the concierge dialog appearing — same root cause. Action: main agent must add a `pointerEvents="none"` / `position: relative` guard, hide the concierge floating widget on incident-workflow routes (/incident, /incident/new, /incident/triage, /incident/investigation, /incident/actions, /incident/close-out), or move the concierge launcher to the safe-area inset. Recommend keeping it hidden on wizard pages entirely. No backend issues observed during the test — the SafeBase backend at https://safe-systems.preview.emergentagent.com returns 401 on /api/incident-workflow/stats without auth (expected) and the wizard's POST attempt could not be triggered to verify the live response.

ui_bugs.component: Concierge floating widget vs Incident wizard
ui_bugs.issue: The global 'TALK TO ME' yellow pill (SafeBase Concierge floating launcher, bottom-right) overlaps the wizard's step-next / submit-incident buttons on /incident/new at mobile viewport 390x844. Tapping the step-next button on Step 2 navigates the user to /concierge ('Ask me anything compliance.') because the browser routes the click to the topmost concierge element. This blocks the entire 5-stage incident submission. The same overlap is likely to hit any wizard-style screen with content tall enough to push the primary CTA into the bottom-right corner.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: a global FloatingActionButton or Concierge launcher (rendered in app/_layout.tsx or a shared ChromeWrapper) is mounted on every authenticated route including /incident/new. On Mobile 390x844 the launcher's hit-box sits at approximately (x: 280..380, y: 740..820) — the same coordinates where the wizard's PrimaryButton 'Next' (testID step-next) lands after Step 2's taller content (description multiline + PhotoPicker block) pushes it lower in the layout. Playwright's force=True click computes the element's center then dispatches a synthetic click; the browser then performs DOM hit-testing and the topmost element under that point is the concierge launcher's TouchableOpacity (higher z-index because it's rendered later in the tree as an absolute-positioned overlay). The launcher's onPress = router.push('/concierge') so the wizard navigates away and the Incident submission state is lost. Mitigation: in the layout component that mounts the concierge launcher, gate its rendering with `const path = usePathname(); if (path?.startsWith('/incident')) return null;` (or guard with a Set of wizard-route prefixes). Alternative: lift the launcher's `bottom` offset to clear the wizard's nav row (e.g. bottom: 120 + safeInsets.bottom on wizard routes), or use pointer-events: none + a smaller hit-box that doesn't overlap the centered step-next button.
